ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a rectangular logic function block, marked internally with “&”, indicating an AND gate. On the left side there are two input lines; the upper input is labeled as the constant “1”, and the lower input is labeled A. On the output line on the right side, at the output terminal of the gate, there is a small circle, indicating output inversion, and it is then connected to the output terminal labeled F. Reasoning: The internal output of the AND gate is 1 AND A. Because 1 AND any logical quantity is equal to that logical quantity, the internal output is A. The small circle at the output terminal indicates inversion of this result, therefore F = \overline{A}.
